description: This file implements shell commands for interacting with the LVGL graphics library within the Zephyr RTOS environment, including monkey input device management and memory statistics.

methods.name: lvgl_monkey_indev_as_string
methods.description: Converts a lv_monkey_t input device to its string representation.

methods.name: lvgl_monkey_indev_from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding lv_indev_type_t.

methods.name: dump_monkey_info
methods.description: Prints information about all active lv_monkey_t instances.

methods.name: cmd_lvgl_monkey
methods.description: Handles the 'lvgl monkey' shell command, displaying monkey info.

methods.name: cmd_lvgl_monkey_create
methods.description: Creates a new lv_monkey_t instance with specified input device type.

methods.name: cmd_lvgl_monkey_set
methods.description: Sets the active/inactive state of a specified lv_monkey_t instance.

methods.name: cmd_lvgl_stats_memory
methods.description: Displays LVGL memory heap info, optionally dumping chunk details.
